ons.text: The Deathwurms are born when Ixidor's Nightmare spell makes Phage regurgitate beetles that become enormous wurms embodying her murders.
Ixidor sends Akroma to fight them, but even the angel cannot stop them, and a deathwurm devours Ixidor after his unmen betray him.
Jeska decides to absorb the wurms back into herself, even though it means becoming Phage again and despising Kamahl.
